title: Fleetbase extension manifest
description: Schema for the `extension.json` file that every Fleetbase extension bundle ships at its root. The manifest names the extension, pins its version and points at the engine (console) and/or api (server) packages the bundle contains.

name.description: Human readable extension name shown in the registry and console.

version.description: Release version of the bundle, as a semantic version (https://semver.org).

description.description: Short summary of what the extension does.

engine.description: The console (Ember engine) package in this bundle: either its npm package name or the manifest file that declares it (`package.json`).

api.description: The server (Laravel) package in this bundle: either its Composer package name or the manifest file that declares it (`composer.json`).

compat.description: Version ranges of the Fleetbase console and API this release is compatible with.

console.description: node-semver style range for `@fleetbase/console`, for example `>=0.7 <1.0`.

api.description: Composer style range for `fleetbase/core-api`, for example `^1.6`.

channel.description: Release channel the bundle is published to. Defaults to `stable` when omitted.

author.description: Author or publisher, for example `Fleetbase Pte Ltd <hello@fleetbase.io>`.

anyOf.$comment: Manifest file name inside the bundle.

versionRange.$comment: Loose check: the characters used by node-semver and Composer range syntax (operators, wildcards, hyphen ranges, `||`).
